proposed_comments.body:
Thanks for the follow-up here. I found a few remaining issues in the new async Clipboard History loading/cache path that should be addressed before merging:

1. `HistoryChanged` now starts the STA history load and materializes image cache files even before the Clipboard History page has ever been opened. That adds background WinRT and disk work to ordinary clipboard activity; gate event-triggered reloads until the page has performed its first `GetItems()` load.
2. The first async load can race the Command Palette view-model subscription: the initial `FetchItems()` can receive the empty snapshot, then the worker can raise `ItemsChanged` before the UI subscribes. Keep the first page load synchronous, or add a handshake that guarantees a post-subscription refresh.
3. Cache writes should be all-or-nothing. Reuse existing item-keyed cache entries, write new entries through a temporary file plus atomic replace, include temporary artifacts in cleanup, and only set `ImagePath` after a successful write; otherwise keep the previous stream-based `HeroImage` fallback.
4. The worker thread and disposal cleanup need a real boundary. Mark the worker as background, track it during disposal, and ensure a disposed/in-flight load cannot recreate cache files that the final cleanup is trying to remove.

The same changes should also keep retry state separate from page-activation state, so a transient `GetHistoryItemsAsync` or bitmap-cache failure does not permanently suppress future clipboard-event refreshes.
